question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
-- Final clean query: percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 
-- and the four weeks following June 15 for years 2018, 2019, 2020
-- 
-- For 2018 & 2019: June 15 falls within week 24, so:
--   Before (4 weeks leading up): weeks 20-23
--   After (4 weeks following): weeks 25-28
-- For 2020: June 15 is exactly week 25 (2020-06-15), so:
--   Before (4 weeks leading up): weeks 21-24
--   After (4 weeks following): weeks 26-29

SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    ROUND(1.0 * (after_sales - before_sales) / before_sales * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN calendar_year IN (2018, 2019) AND week_number BETWEEN 20 AND 23 THEN sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales
            ELSE 0
        END) AS before_sales,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN calendar_year IN (2018, 2019) AND week_number BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN sales
            WHEN calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 29 THEN sales
            ELSE 0
        END) AS after_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
      AND (
          (calendar_year IN (2018, 2019) AND week_number BETWEEN 20 AND 28)
          OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 29)
      )
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
ORDER BY calendar_year
